_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Ballistic Acceptance Test Report
summary: The Ballistic Acceptance Test Report records the summarized results for each phase of ballistic acceptance testing required by an item detail specification, serving as an official firing and acceptance record.
description_purpose:
This DID identifies the format and content requirement covered by the specific and discrete task for the contractor to prepare this data product identified in the contract Statement of Work (SOW).
The Ballistic Acceptance Test Report records the summarized results for each phase of the ballistic acceptance testing required by an item detail specification. It serves as an official firing and acceptance record.
application_interrelationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for that data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement for this data included in the contract.
This DID applies to all phases of the life cycle of an item.
This DID supersedes DI-R-1727, Quality Inspection Ballistic Acceptance Test.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Contract.
preparation_instructions.content: This data item is generated by the contract which contains a specific and discrete work task to develop this data product.

preparation_instructions.title: General.
preparation_instructions.content: The data to be reported encompasses testing requirements prescribed by the item detail specification.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Ballistic Acceptance Test Report shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: Each Ballistic Acceptance Test Report shall contain the following:

children.title: Item detail specification number and title (including any amendment).
Total rounds expended on test (listed by test phases when applicable).
One-page summary of test performed, and overall results.
Detailed results of each applicable phase.

preparation_instructions.title: Detailed Contents.
preparation_instructions.content: In addition to the general contents, the following detailed contents shall be provided as cited in the item detail specification(s) in the contract:

children.title: Projectile Extraction
children.content: Requirement shall be shown and the individual cartridge results reported. Findings of propellant contamination examinations shall also be reported.

children.title: Projectile Torque
children.content: Requirement shall be shown and number out of sample meeting requirement reported.

children.title: Velocity, Pressure, Water Proofness
children.content: Requirements shall be shown and the individual round readings recorded. Both the means and sample standard deviation shall be computed and recorded. If corrections are applied, the basis for the corrections shall be fully documented and the corrected or uncorrected means shown. Test barrels shall be identified by number and age (rounds).

children.title: Accuracy
children.content: The Horizontal and vertical standard deviations for each target shall be recorded as well as the pooled values. Wind conditions, temperature, barometric pressure, target distance, and test barrel identification (and round age) shall also be reported.

children.title: Action Time
children.content: Individual times shall be recorded for each sample cartridge and the mean and standard deviation computed and reported.

children.title: Projectile Trace
children.content: Trace times for each individual sample cartridge shall be reported. Light and temperature conditions, as well as test barrel(s) identification and round history, shall also be reported.

children.title: Function and Casualty
children.content: Record test weapon(s) and barrel(s) identifications and round ages, individual cyclic rates, and witness screen observations.

children.title: Penetration
children.content: Record velocity and penetration results and depict all computational values. Test barrel information is also required.

children.title: Projectile Function
children.content: Report sample rounds fired and number of successful rounds fired for each type of check (i.e., impact nonfunction, impact function, target sensitivity, projectile self destruct). Test weapons or barrel(s) identification (and round age) shall also be reported.
